package.name: arena_social_cost_layer
package.description: Nav2 costmap_2d::Layer that paints social cost (personal space + HHI group/O-space clearance) from arena_peds (arena_people_msgs/Pedestrians), modulated by animation_state and interaction_id/interaction_type. Used for the ANIM-on/ANIM-off ablation between letting a robot perceive human animation/interaction signals vs. locomotion-only humans.
